premises.text: Cross-border payment platforms are territorial and poorly tailored for global creator and entrepreneur payouts
premises.evidence_span: Stripe, PayPal, Payoneer, all building cross-border payments that are territorial and not tailored to these needs

premises.text: Integrating multiple country payment APIs is complex, slow, fee-heavy, and requires technical expertise that bars most digital entrepreneurs
premises.evidence_span: integrating with multiple payment APIs in different countries is incredibly complex

premises.text: A unified API ecosystem abstracts multi-provider payment complexity so non-technical users can accept global payments without code
premises.evidence_span: abstracts the complexity of integrating with multiple payment platforms, enabling non-technical entrepreneurs and creators to get access to global payment options without writing any single line of code

premises.text: No-code suites for websites, storefronts, invoicing, and media kits convert users by letting them showcase work and get paid in one place
premises.evidence_span: we enable them with no-code suites that make it easier for them to showcase their work and receive payments via websites, storefronts, invoicing, Media Kit, and more

premises.text: A single Mainstack account plus compliance approval grants intermediary access to multiple payment providers
premises.evidence_span: she creates a single account on Mainstack and completes our compliance requirement

premises.text: Real-time IP/geolocation detection chooses which payment API to call to avoid transaction hiccups
premises.evidence_span: sophisticated IP detection system that dynamically, in real time, analyzes Sandra's client's geolocation

value.text: Anyone anywhere can showcase work and receive secure global customer payments in minutes
value.evidence_span: enabling anyone from anywhere to showcase their work and receive payment from their customers in a simple and highly secure manner starting in minutes

international payments are a necessity for many entrepreneurs and creators like Sandra to reach their full potential
get access to global payment options without writing any single line of code
